name: list_subsystems
description: The cluster's subsystems: name (sub), what their units are called, how they relate, tables.

name: get_manifest
description: A subsystem's manifest: the unit's fields (type, required, enum options and their labels, fixed, secret), field labels and the console form. Call it before writing a plan.

name: find_units

field.description: a field of the unit, or about.<field> of the related unit

value.description: the value; a list for in/not_in

fields.description: which fields to return (all if omitted); about.<field> — the value of that field of the related unit (e.g. its counter's step)

name: field_values
description: Which values of a field occur among a subsystem's units (labels, zones, shelves, modes) and how many; about.<field> — values of a field of the related unit. Map the admin's words ("northern", "top floor") to these values.

name: list_table
description: Rows of a subsystem's table (e.g. rec's volumes). Read only.

name: rule_state
description: A rule's state: its phase, reason, unfit and unchecked words, the runs that wait.

name: rule_fires
description: A rule's fires of the last day from the journal, newest first.

name: answer
description: The answer to the admin, in words; ends the turn. Nothing is changed.

name: ask_admin
description: Ask the admin one short question when the request does not name the unit, the field or the value. The admin's answer comes back as the result.

other_kind.description: true: the request is of another kind (a change, a rule, a question about the system, a list), not for this assistant
